question: Is debug logging on for this user, and what are their latest logs?

steps.name: u
steps.soql: SELECT Id FROM User WHERE Username = '{user}'

steps.name: flags
steps.soql: SELECT LogType, StartDate, ExpirationDate, DebugLevel.DeveloperName FROM TraceFlag WHERE TracedEntityId IN ({@u.Id}) ORDER BY ExpirationDate DESC

steps.name: logs
steps.soql: SELECT Id, StartTime, Operation, Status, LogLength, DurationMilliseconds FROM ApexLog WHERE LogUserId IN ({@u.Id}) ORDER BY StartTime DESC LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: No live trace flag for {user}: no new logs are being written.
Logging is on for {user}; {logs.rows} recent log(s).

traps: Read a log body with: sf apex get log -i <Id>.
